direction: R11 G12 closure (SPARC hierarchical forward model)
data_source: 175 SPARC galaxies from v0.1-prelim/data/Rotmod_LTG/ (Lelli, McGaugh, Schombert 2016c, AJ 152, 157). Population synthesis via Dutton & Macciò 2014 concentration-mass relation (log-normal scatter 0.13 dex). SIDM core radius scaling per Roberts+ 2024 / Kaplinghat+ 2016.
